SELECT u.user_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.profile_img AS profileImg,
sp.description AS description, sp.rating_avg AS ratingAvg, sp.total_reviews AS totalReviews, sp.total_sales AS totalSales FROM users u JOIN seller_profile sp ON sp.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{sellerId}

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS title, p.price AS price, p.main_image_url AS thumbnailUrl, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM products p WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND p.sales_status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS title, p.price AS price, p.main_image_url AS thumbnailUrl, p.updated_at AS createdAt FROM products p WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND p.sales_status = 'SOLD' ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT r.id AS reviewId, r.rating AS rating, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS createdAt,
bu.nickname AS buyerNickname, bu.profile_img AS buyerProfileImg,
p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productTitle, p.main_image_url AS productThumbnailImg
FROM reviews r JOIN users bu ON bu.user_id = r.buyer_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.seller_id = #{sellerId}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
ORDER BY r.rating DESC
ORDER BY r.rating ASC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
